title: Dynamics 365 Finance: AI import of customer payment remittance advice for settlement
summary: Held because three generalisations about customer remittance contents are not established by the Microsoft text checked: customer names, invoice references and payment amounts. The roadmap facts match, and feature-specific controls remain undocumented; the licensing field also understates the published Dynamics 365 product licensing requirement.
